entries.title: Define the Scientific Question and Computational Objective
entries.disposition: Move scientific framing outside the core operation ontology; retain executable protocol and claim-assessment semantics.

entries.title: Initialize the Project, Directory Structure, and Provenance
entries.disposition: Separate directory practice from provenance capture and reproducibility packaging.

entries.title: Acquire Source Structures and Reference Data
entries.disposition: Retain with a narrower source-acquisition contract.

entries.title: Parse, Clean, and Standardize Structures
entries.disposition: Split parsing, integrity verification, and crystallographic canonicalization.

entries.title: Build the Computational Model
entries.disposition: Retain with an explicit boundary excluding candidate enumeration and theory selection.

entries.title: Enumerate Candidate Configurations
entries.disposition: Retain and generalize across magnetic orders, defects, adsorption, stacking, disorder, and conformers.

entries.title: Choose the Electronic-Structure Method
entries.disposition: Retain as physical-theory and ensemble specification.

entries.title: Choose Pseudopotentials, PAW Datasets, Basis Sets, and Core Treatment
entries.disposition: Treat as part of numerical representation and compatibility constraints.

entries.title: Set Boundary Conditions and Long-Range Interactions
entries.disposition: Separate physical model boundaries from numerical long-range treatments.

entries.title: Design Numerical Convergence Tests
entries.disposition: Separate pre-run convergence design from execution and judgment.

entries.title: Plan the Workflow and Calculation Dependencies
entries.disposition: Represent protocol design and runtime orchestration separately.

entries.title: Generate Inputs and Perform Preflight Checks
entries.disposition: Retain as input materialization and static preflight.

entries.title: Configure the Runtime Environment and HPC Resources
entries.disposition: Retain.

entries.title: Submit, Monitor, and Control Calculations
entries.disposition: Retain and extend with restart, error classification, recovery, and dependency revision.

entries.title: Run the Ground-State SCF Calculation
entries.disposition: Generalize SCF to the electronic-state solver operation; SCF is a subtype.

entries.title: Optimize Atomic Positions and the Simulation Cell
entries.disposition: Generalize to constrained structure, cell, collective-variable, and path optimization.

entries.title: Run the High-Accuracy Static Ground-State Calculation
entries.disposition: Treat high accuracy as an O13 execution profile plus observable-specific O20 convergence.

entries.title: Inspect Calculation Status and Initial Numerical Results
entries.disposition: Separate runtime state, output parsing, and numerical completion.

entries.title: Calculate Band Structures, Density of States, and Fermi Surfaces
entries.disposition: Retain as recipes and targets, not one atomic operation.

entries.title: Analyze Charge Density, Electrostatic Potential, and Chemical Bonding
entries.disposition: Retain as a family of analysis recipes.

entries.title: Study Magnetism
entries.disposition: Represent magnetism as a target and recipe assembled from reusable operations.

entries.title: Calculate Equations of State and Structural Phase Stability
entries.disposition: Separate equation-of-state sampling from cross-structure phase comparison.

entries.title: Calculate Elastic, Mechanical, and Piezoelectric Properties
entries.disposition: Split response evaluation from derived mechanical observables.

entries.title: Calculate Phonons and Harmonic Vibrational Properties
entries.disposition: Represent as a composite finite-displacement or DFPT recipe.

entries.title: Study Anharmonicity, Thermodynamics, and Lattice Thermal Transport
entries.disposition: Represent as a recipe family rather than one action.

entries.title: Calculate Electron-Phonon Coupling and Conventional Superconductivity
entries.disposition: Separate coupling data, interpolation, superconducting observables, and validation.

entries.title: Study Defects, Doping, and Disorder
entries.disposition: Represent system features and multiple recipes, not one operation.

entries.title: Study Surfaces, Interfaces, Adsorption, and Layered Systems
entries.disposition: Represent system types and recipes.

entries.title: Calculate Reaction Paths, Diffusion, and Kinetic Barriers
entries.disposition: Split path generation, optimization, barrier derivation, and validation.

entries.title: Calculate Dielectric, Polarization, Ferroelectric, and Response Properties
entries.disposition: Separate response evaluation from candidate phases and derived observables.

entries.title: Calculate Optical, Spectroscopic, and Excited-State Properties
entries.disposition: Split independent-particle, TDDFT, GW/BSE, and spectroscopy recipes.

entries.title: Build Wannier Models and Study Berry Phases, Topology, and Transport
entries.disposition: Keep reduced-model construction separate from topology and transport targets.

entries.title: Run Molecular Dynamics, Finite-Temperature Simulations, and Sampling
entries.disposition: Retain propagation and sampling as O15; keep analysis and convergence separate.

entries.title: Go Beyond Conventional Kohn–Sham DFT
entries.disposition: Remove as a catch-all operation; represent GW, BSE, DMFT, and related methods as tags and recipes.

entries.title: Post-Process, Validate, Compare, Archive, and Reuse Results
entries.disposition: Split parsing, derivation, comparison, numerical verification, physical validation, claim assessment, provenance, and preservation.
